territorial_scope.description: Applies in Spain as state labour legislation amending the Workers' Statute, enacted under the state's exclusive competence over labour law.

evidence.quote: Esta Ley se dicta al amparo de lo dispuesto en el artículo 149.1.7.ª de la Constitución Española, que atribuye al Estado la competencia exclusiva en materia de legislación laboral.

summary.short: Amends Spain's Workers' Statute to give works councils information on parameters, rules and instructions of algorithms or AI systems affecting working conditions and employment; creates a presumption that delivery work organised via algorithmic management on digital platforms falls within the Statute. Enters into force the day after BOE publication.
summary.long: Law 12/2021 amends the consolidated Workers' Statute (Real Decreto Legislativo 2/2015) in two respects. First, it adds letter d) to Article 64(4), giving the works council the right to be informed by the company of the parameters, rules and instructions on which algorithms or AI systems are based where they affect decisions that may bear on working conditions, access to and maintenance of employment, including profiling. Second, it adds Additional Provision 23, which creates a presumption that the activity of persons performing paid delivery or distribution of consumer products or goods is included in the Statute's scope where the employer exercises organisational, direction and control powers, directly, indirectly or implicitly, through algorithmic management of the service or working conditions via a digital platform. The presumption does not affect Article 1.3 of the Statute. The law is enacted under the state's exclusive competence over labour legislation (Article 149.1.7.ª of the Constitution) and enters into force the day after its publication in the BOE. The text contains no separate sanctions provisions.

notes: Registry title omits 'en el ámbito de' before 'plataformas digitales'; the document title is authoritative. The preamble's description of one article and two final provisions matches the body. The entry-into-force date (30/09/2021) appears only in the BOE metadata block, not the operative text; the text says it enters into force the day after publication. The presumption in the new provision is worded 'se presume incluida en el ámbito de esta ley', without naming the Estatuto in the operative text.

thresholds.note: No numeric cutoff changing legal treatment in the operative provisions (Art. único: new art. 64.4 d) ET and new DA 23ª ET; Disposición final segunda). The numbers in the text are dates, article and case references, and the Constitution's art. 149.1.7.ª, none of which set scope, eligibility, obligations or penalties. The presumption in DA 23ª depends on qualitative criteria (direct, indirect or implicit exercise of employer powers through algorithmic management), not a numeric threshold.
